Auth.anonymousHelp: Look around with your CV and no account. Anything you leave is deleted after 24 hours.

signIn.title: Sign in and read today’s Brief.
signIn.lead: Pemby watches companies’ own careers pages while you’re away, and tells you which of them can hire you where you live.

signUp.title: Create an account and keep what you’ve started.
signUp.lead: An account is what lets Pemby reach you — on Telegram, by email or on this browser — and it keeps the CV you dropped from being deleted after 24 hours.
signUp.closedBody: Sign in and pick up where you left off.

reset.setLead: Pick a new password. Setting it signs out every session that was open with the old one.

verify.nextBody: Sign in, confirm a few short cards about where you can work from and how you want to work, and your Brief starts from there.

Forbidden.cardBody: You may be signed in as someone else, or this part of Pemby may not be open to this account yet.
